column1: # Past resolutions for the suggestion benchmark (ADR-040). Synthetic, written for this benchmark; no real tickets.
# Three fixes per category, so every new ticket has same-category distractors.

column3: title
column4: description
column5: rootCause
column6: stepsTaken
column7: preventiveAction

column3: VPN gateway refuses AnyConnect logins
column4: Remote staff get a certificate error when the AnyConnect client connects to the VPN gateway.
column5: Expired TLS certificate on the VPN gateway
column6: Renewed the gateway certificate and restarted the VPN service
column7: Certificate expiry monitoring with a 30 day alert

column3: Office wifi drops every few minutes on floor 3
column4: Laptops on the third floor lose the wireless network and reconnect again and again.
column5: Two access points broadcasting on the same wifi channel
column6: Moved one access point to another channel and lowered its transmit power
column7: Channel plan reviewed after every access point change

column3: Internal sites do not resolve
column4: Browsers say the intranet host cannot be found; external websites still open.
column5: DNS forwarder lost its zone for the internal domain
column6: Restored the internal DNS zone and flushed the resolver cache
column7: DNS zone backups and a synthetic lookup check

column3: Reporting queries time out on the postgres replica
column4: Month-end reports never finish and the replica shows long running queries.
column5: Missing index on the transactions table after a schema migration
column6: Recreated the index on the replica and analysed the table
column7: Migration checklist verifies indexes on replicas

column3: Application cannot open database connections
column4: The order service logs too many connections from the postgres server.
column5: Connection pool leak in a batch job holding sessions open
column6: Restarted the batch job and capped its connection pool
column7: Pool size alerts on the database server

column3: SQL Server deadlocks on the billing tables
column4: Billing updates fail with deadlock victim errors several times an hour.
column5: Two procedures update the billing tables in opposite order
column6: Changed the procedures to lock tables in the same order
column7: Code review rule for lock order in procedures

column3: Laptop battery drains within an hour
column4: A new laptop shuts down after an hour even when the battery shows full.
column5: Faulty battery cell reported by the battery diagnostics
column6: Replaced the laptop battery under warranty
column7: Battery health check during laptop setup

column3: Docking station does not drive the external monitor
column4: The second monitor stays black when the laptop sits in the docking station.
column5: Outdated docking station firmware
column6: Updated the dock firmware and the display driver
column7: Dock firmware included in the monthly update cycle

column3: Office printer prints blank pages
column4: The floor printer feeds paper but the pages come out empty.
column5: Empty toner cartridge with a stuck sensor
column6: Replaced the toner cartridge and cleaned the toner sensor
column7: Toner level alerts sent to the service desk

column3: Excel crashes when opening macro workbooks
column4: Excel closes without a message whenever a workbook with macros is opened.
column5: Corrupted Office add-in loaded at start-up
column6: Removed the add-in and repaired the Office installation
column7: Add-ins deployed only through the software catalogue

column3: Outlook does not sync the calendar
column4: Meetings accepted on the phone never appear in the Outlook calendar.
column5: Corrupted Outlook profile cache
column6: Recreated the Outlook profile and rebuilt the offline cache
column7: Profile repair guide published for the service desk

column3: Software update fails with an installer error
column4: The monthly software update stops with installer error 1603 on several laptops.
column5: Previous installer left a pending reboot flag
column6: Rebooted the laptops and reran the installer
column7: Update job checks for pending reboots first

column3: Phishing email asking for payroll passwords
column4: Several staff received an email pretending to be payroll asking them to confirm passwords.
column5: Phishing campaign spoofing the payroll sender domain
column6: Blocked the sender domain, purged the emails and reset affected passwords
column7: Phishing awareness training and stricter sender checks

column3: Antivirus flags malware on a shared drive
column4: The antivirus quarantines a file on the finance shared drive every morning.
column5: Infected macro document copied from a contractor laptop
column6: Removed the malware, scanned the drive and isolated the laptop
column7: Contractor laptops scanned before network access

column3: Suspicious logins from abroad on an admin account
column4: Security alerts show admin logins from another country at night.
column5: Leaked admin password reused on a public site
column6: Disabled the account, rotated credentials and enforced mfa
column7: MFA required for every administrator account

column3: Users locked out after the password change
column4: Many users cannot log in after the quarterly password change.
column5: Old password cached on phones keeps failing and locks the account
column6: Unlocked the accounts and removed the cached password on the phones
column7: Password change guide covers mobile devices

column3: MFA codes rejected at login
column4: The authenticator app codes are always rejected when signing in.
column5: Clock drift on the authentication server
column6: Synchronised the server clock with the time source
column7: Time sync monitoring on authentication servers

column3: Single sign-on loops back to the login page
column4: After entering credentials the SSO page redirects back to the login again.
column5: Expired SAML signing certificate for the identity provider
column6: Uploaded the new SAML certificate to the identity provider and the app
column7: SAML certificate expiry calendar

column3: Checkout page returns HTTP 500
column4: Customers see an internal server error when they press pay on the checkout page.
column5: Payment API key expired in the checkout service configuration
column6: Rotated the payment API key and redeployed the checkout service
column7: API key expiry tracked in the release calendar

column3: HR portal is very slow at login
column4: The HR portal takes over a minute to show the dashboard after login.
column5: Unbounded session cache in the portal application server
column6: Limited the session cache and restarted the application server
column7: Heap and cache size dashboards for the portal

column3: Mobile banking app crashes on start
column4: The banking app closes immediately on start for Android users after the release.
column5: Null pointer in the new release when the feature flag service is down
column6: Rolled back the release and added a default for the feature flag
column7: Release tests run with the flag service unavailable

column3: Kubernetes pods restart in a loop
column4: The payment pods on the cluster restart again and again with CrashLoopBackOff.
column5: Pod memory limit lower than the application needs after an upgrade
column6: Raised the memory limit in the deployment and redeployed the pods
column7: Load test sizes memory limits before release

column3: AWS bill doubled this month
column4: The cloud cost report shows the AWS spend doubled without a new project.
column5: Forgotten test cluster left running in another region
column6: Deleted the unused cluster and its volumes
column7: Budget alerts per account and region

column3: Azure storage uploads fail with authorization errors
column4: Uploads to the Azure storage account fail with an authorization error.
column5: Expired shared access signature token in the upload service
column6: Generated a new SAS token and updated the service secret
column7: SAS tokens rotated by a scheduled job

column3: Shared drive is full
column4: Nobody can save files on the department shared drive, it reports no space left.
column5: File share quota reached by old video exports
column6: Archived the old exports and raised the quota
column7: Quota alerts at 85 percent

column3: Nightly backup job fails
column4: The nightly backup of the file server fails with a timeout every night.
column5: Backup window too short after the data growth
column6: Moved the backup to an incremental schedule and extended the window
column7: Backup duration trend reviewed monthly

column3: SAN volume shows read errors
column4: The storage array reports read errors on one volume of the database server.
column5: Failing disk in the SAN array
column6: Replaced the failed disk and let the array rebuild the volume
column7: Disk health alerts from the array
